commands.name: StartSlaReportGeneration
steps: resolve Daily/Weekly/Monthly/selected-range boundaries in fixed America/Guayaquil and canonical UTC; validate optional Customer scope and output extension/path
capture canonical as_of_utc
inside short UoW insert receipt/report_attempt state=staging and one durable LLD-01 report job ref containing only bounded attempt/scope/destination tokens
audit start and commit
worker begins REPORT_SNAPSHOT_V1
rules: Objective timezone never changes boundaries
start does not create completed evidence or alter operational state
selected range is a progress/report view over canonical monthly cohorts, not a new contractual cohort definition

commands.name: StageReportSnapshotBatch
steps: require at least one row; validate exact section schemas, canonical row ordering, payload hashes and batch_payload_sha256 outside writer lock

inside bounded UoW resolve command receipt first: exact committed command_id/command_type/request_hash replay returns the original ReportSnapshotBatchResultV1 before stale-revision checks; any mismatch is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
revalidate attempt=staging, expected revision and exact current durable-job snapshot_generation_token
insert one command receipt before any attempt-owned staging row or last_command_id reference
insert only normalized/minimized report snapshot rows produced by the still-open stable accepted-state reader
update exact member/cohort/section counters, attempt revision and last_command_id; construct ReportSnapshotBatchResultV1 and commit atomically
rules: the durable worker assigns one UUID command_id to the exact generation/batch before first invocation and reuses it for every retry of that same batch
COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 binds report_attempt_id, generation token, batch ordinal, canonical batch hash, expected revision and normalized row content
staging rows are not CompletedReportEvidence
batch never reads live domain state itself and cannot mutate SR/classification/policy/contributor authority
rollback removes receipt, rows, counters and revision together; a committed replay cannot duplicate rows or counters

commands.name: SealReportSnapshot
steps: after every registered contributor reaches complete EOF, compute canonical snapshot_hash and exact final counts from the same stable read generation

inside one bounded UoW resolve command receipt first: exact committed command_id/command_type/request_hash replay returns the original ReportAttemptTransitionResultV1 before current state/revision/token checks; any mismatch is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
revalidate attempt=staging, expected revision and exact current durable-job snapshot_generation_token
insert one command receipt before last_command_id reference
recompute persisted member/tier/cohort/registered-section canonical order and snapshot SHA-256 together with exact report request metadata; recompute exact persisted member/cohort/section counts
require all recomputed values equal the request exactly; any count/order/hash/generation mismatch fails closed with no transition
set snapshot_hash/final counts/state=ready_to_generate/revision/last_command_id, append bounded progress audit, construct ReportAttemptTransitionResultV1 and commit atomically
rules: the durable worker assigns one UUID command_id to the exact seal intent before first invocation and reuses it for every retry
COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 binds report_attempt_id, snapshot_generation_token, expected revision, exact final counts and canonical snapshot_hash
stable read snapshot must remain logically complete through contributor EOF and the seal token must identify that exact staging generation
no completed authority exists at seal; staged rows become sealed generation inputs only
rollback removes receipt, seal transition and audit together; exact committed replay cannot reseal or advance revision twice

commands.name: MarkReportGenerating
steps: inside one bounded UoW resolve command receipt first: exact committed command_id/command_type/request_hash replay returns the original ReportAttemptTransitionResultV1 before current state/revision checks; any mismatch is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
revalidate attempt=ready_to_generate, expected revision, non-null sealed snapshot_hash equal to request and persisted sealed counts
insert one command receipt before last_command_id reference
set state=generating, increment revision, set last_command_id, append bounded progress audit, construct ReportAttemptTransitionResultV1 and commit atomically
after commit the XLSX writer may read only the same sealed report_attempt_id + snapshot_hash through SLA_REPORT_XLSX_V1
rules: the durable worker assigns one UUID command_id to this exact transition before first invocation and reuses it on every retry
COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 binds report_attempt_id, expected revision and exact sealed snapshot_hash
the transition never changes snapshot_hash, staged rows or counts
crash after commit but before/during artifact writing safely replays the generating transition and regenerates deterministically from the same sealed snapshot
rollback removes receipt, transition and audit together; exact committed replay cannot advance revision or audit twice

commands.name: MarkReportVerifying
steps: after SLA_REPORT_XLSX_V1 writer closes the sibling temporary candidate, validate candidate_filename as a bounded filename-only identity with no directory/absolute/traversal component; do not read the artifact while holding a writer transaction

inside one bounded UoW resolve command receipt first: exact committed command_id/command_type/request_hash replay returns the original ReportAttemptTransitionResultV1 before current state/revision checks; any mismatch is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
revalidate attempt=generating, expected revision, exact non-null sealed snapshot_hash/count metadata and absence of verified artifact hash/size/verified_at authority
insert one command receipt before last_command_id reference

set state=verifying, store candidate_filename in artifact_filename as unverified candidate identity, increment revision, set last_command_id, append bounded progress audit, construct ReportAttemptTransitionResultV1 and commit atomically

after commit reopen and verify exactly that candidate through the existing validated destination context/job token; verification returns metadata for CompleteSlaReport but performs no database mutation itself
rules: the durable worker assigns one UUID command_id to this exact transition before first invocation and reuses it on every retry
COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 binds report_attempt_id, expected revision, exact sealed snapshot_hash and candidate_filename
candidate_filename is not a path authority and is not completed artifact evidence; artifact_sha256/artifact_size_bytes/verified_at_utc remain unset until CompleteSlaReport accepts VALID verification
the transition never changes snapshot_hash, staged rows or counts

crash after commit but before/during verification safely replays the verifying transition and may reverify only the exact safe candidate identity; if recovery must regenerate, it regenerates from the same sealed snapshot according to worker recovery policy
rollback removes receipt, candidate metadata, transition and audit together; exact committed replay cannot advance revision or audit twice

commands.name: CompleteSlaReport
steps: inside UoW require state=verifying and exact sealed snapshot hash
require verification VALID and nonempty artifact
recompute exact staged member/tier/cohort/section counts and immutable policy/classification/source/section schema references
insert/reuse receipt
set artifact filename/hash/size/verified_at/state=completed/completed_at/revision
append completion audit/result refs and commit
rules: this transaction is the authority transition: all staged snapshot rows become immutable CompletedReportEvidence
later operational/policy/contact/customer/contributor changes never update completed attempt or child rows
completion does not trigger cleanup/archive/purge

commands.name: FailSlaReportAttempt
steps: inside UoW require not completed
insert/reuse receipt
delete only attempt-owned staged SLA member/tier/cohort and report_section_snapshots rows while they are non-authoritative
set attempt failed/failure_code/completed_at/revision and clear snapshot/artifact candidate metadata not proven completed plus staged counts
audit bounded failure and commit
best-effort delete temporary external candidate through filesystem adapter outside domain transaction
rules: failed attempt retains no complete report snapshot population
failure never changes operational records/classification/policy/contributor data
temporary-file deletion failure is diagnostic housekeeping, not completed report evidence

commands.name: CancelSlaReportAttempt
steps: request durable job cancellation at a safe boundary

once worker is outside artifact finalization/completed transition, inside UoW insert receipt/delete all non-authoritative staged SLA and registered-section children/set counters zero/state cancelled/completed_at/revision/audit/commit
clean temporary artifact best-effort outside transaction
rules: completed report cannot be cancelled
cancellation creates no completed evidence and no operational cleanup

worker_recovery: startup resumes report jobs only from committed attempt state and sealed snapshot metadata

staging attempt with interrupted stable-read generation cannot guess completeness; discard all staged child rows through Fail/restart path or rebuild from a new attempt according to durable-job policy
ready_to_generate/generating may regenerate artifact deterministically from sealed snapshot
verifying may reverify an existing candidate only when destination token/candidate identity is exact and safe; otherwise regenerate from sealed snapshot
completed attempts are never regenerated into changed evidence; optional re-export of a completed snapshot is a distinct future/explicit artifact action and does not alter evidence
